terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: The agreement between you and FundedBeyond Academy for using our courses, assessments, certificates and community.

blocks.text: FundedBeyond Academy (the "Academy", "we", "us") is an online trading-education platform at academy.fundedbeyond.com. It is operated by Beyond Edge FZCO, a company registered in the International Free Zone Authority (IFZA), Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") apply whenever you visit the Academy, create an account, take a course or assessment, or post in the community. Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle your personal data and forms part of these Terms. To create an account you must tick the box confirming that you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. No account is opened until you do. By using the Academy you also agree to both. If you do not agree, please do not use the Academy.
This summary is here to help you find your way. The full sections below are what count.

items: You must be 18 or older to use the Academy.
The Academy teaches trading. It does not give financial advice, manage money or run trading accounts.
Some courses are free and some are paid. Prices and what you get are shown before you pay.
All payments are final. We do not give refunds or compensation in any case.
Course material is for your own learning. Please do not share or resell it.
Treat other learners with respect, and take assessments honestly.
You can close your account at any time.
Trading carries a real risk of loss. Nothing you learn here guarantees profits or a funded account.

blocks.text: You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you live if that is higher, and able to enter into a binding contract. The Academy is not intended for children and we do not knowingly allow anyone under 18 to register.
You may not use the Academy if you are barred from receiving our services under the laws that apply to you, or if we have previously closed your account for breaking these Terms.

You can register with an email address and password, or with Google. Either way, your account is only created after you tick the box confirming that you are 18 or older and agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. We record when you agreed and to which version. Please give us accurate information and keep it up to date.

items: Keep your password and sign-in details private. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
Tell us straight away at support@fundedbeyond.com if you think someone else has used your account.
One account per person. Do not share an account, sell it, or let someone else learn or take assessments under your name.
Staff, instructor and administrator accounts are given by us and may only be used for that role.

sections.title: What the Academy Is, and What It Is Not

blocks.text: The Academy offers courses, lessons, videos, quizzes and assessments, a trader diagnostic, progress tracking, readiness indicators, certificates and a members' community. Which features you see can depend on the courses you are enrolled in.
Education, not advice

Everything in the Academy is general education. It is not financial, investment, tax or legal advice, and it is not a recommendation to buy or sell any instrument. Instructors and community members speak for themselves, not for us. You alone decide how and whether to trade.
FundedBeyond challenges are separate

Prop-trading challenges, evaluations and funded accounts are offered through fundedbeyond.com under its own terms. The Academy may show you readiness scores or links to those programmes, but buying a challenge is a separate contract with its own rules. Finishing a course, earning a certificate or reaching a readiness score does not entitle you to a challenge, a discount, funding or any trading outcome.

Some courses and features are free. Others require payment. Before you pay, the course page or checkout shows the price, the currency, any taxes, and what you get, including how long you will have access.

items: Payments are handled by a third-party payment processor shown at checkout. We do not see or store your full card or bank details.
All payments are final and non-refundable (see No Refunds).
Prices include or add taxes such as VAT or GST where the law requires.
If a course page does not state an access period, you keep access for as long as the Academy offers that course.
We may change prices for future purchases. A price change never affects a purchase you have already made.
If a payment fails or is reversed, we may pause access to the paid course until it is settled.

blocks.text: If we ever offer recurring plans, the plan page will explain how often you are charged and how to cancel, and you can cancel at any time before the next billing date.
All purchases are final. Please read the course page carefully, and try our free courses and the diagnostic, before you buy.

items: We do not give refunds, in full or in part, for any purchase, whether or not you start, finish or use the course.

We do not give credits, compensation or other payments for any reason, including dissatisfaction, change of mind, technical problems on your side, account suspension or closure, or changes to the Academy.
If you are charged twice or charged an amount that does not match the price shown at checkout, contact us and we will correct the billing error.
If you cancel a recurring plan, if we offer one, you are not charged again, but you are not refunded for the current period.

blocks.text: This does not take away any right you have that the law where you live does not allow a business to exclude.
Quizzes, assessments and the diagnostic must be your own work. Do not get help from another person, share questions or answers, or use tools to complete them for you.

Some assessments use monitoring to protect their integrity. The assessment tells you before you start, and asks for your agreement, if it records browser activity (such as leaving the page or copying text) or uses your camera and microphone. Our Privacy Policy explains what is collected and how long it is kept.

When you earn a certificate, it gets a unique link that anyone you share it with can use to check it is genuine. That page shows your name, the course and the date issued. Certificates are kept permanently as part of our records, and their links keep working, even if you later close or delete your account. We may withdraw a certificate if it was earned through cheating or a breach of these Terms.
The community is for members to learn from each other. Anything you post or upload, such as posts, comments, questions, assignment answers or your profile photo, is "your content".

items: You keep ownership of your content.
If you delete your account, your posts, comments and messages stay in the community so conversations still make sense, but they are shown as written by a deleted member instead of your name.

You give us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, display, copy and adapt your content as needed to run the Academy, for example to show your post to other members. This licence continues for content that stays in the community after your account is deleted.
Only post content you have the right to share, and do not post anyone's personal information without their permission.
We may review, hide or remove content that breaks these Terms or the law, and we may restrict accounts that repeatedly do so.

blocks.text: If you send us ideas or feedback about the Academy, we may use them freely without paying you or giving you credit.
When using the Academy, you must not:

items: harass, threaten, abuse or discriminate against anyone;
promote trading signals, schemes or products, or claim guaranteed returns;
advertise or sell anything to members without our written permission;
copy, record, download, share or resell course videos, materials or assessment questions, except where the Academy offers a download for your own use;
share your account or paid access with anyone else;
pretend to be another person, an instructor or a member of our team;
scrape or harvest content or member data, or use automated tools, bots or AI agents to access the Academy, except through features we provide for that purpose;
try to get around access controls, assessment monitoring, rate limits or other security measures;
probe, attack or overload our systems, or upload malware;
use the Academy for anything unlawful.

blocks.text: If you break these rules we may remove content, withdraw certificates, or suspend or close your account. Where it is serious, we may report it to the authorities.
The courses, videos, text, assessments, software, designs, logos and the FundedBeyond name belong to us or the people who license them to us, and are protected by intellectual property law.

While you have access to a course, we give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use it for your own learning. You may keep private notes. Any other use, including copying, sharing, publishing, reselling or creating courses from our material, needs our written permission.
If you believe something on the Academy infringes your rights, email support@fundedbeyond.com with details and we will look into it promptly.

The Academy works with services run by other companies, for example Google for sign-in, YouTube for some lesson videos, and our payment processor. When you use them, their own terms and privacy policies also apply. The Academy also links to fundedbeyond.com and other websites we do not control, and we are not responsible for their content or practices.

You can stop using the Academy and close your account at any time, from your account settings or by emailing support@fundedbeyond.com. Closing your account ends your access to all courses, including paid ones, so save copies of any certificates you want to keep first.

We may suspend or close your account, or remove access to a course, if you break these Terms, if we need to for legal or security reasons, or if your account has been inactive and unused for an extended period. Where it is reasonable, we will tell you first and give you a chance to respond. Closing or suspending an account, by you or by us, does not entitle you to a refund or compensation.
If we stop offering a paid course before the access period you paid for ends, we will tell you in advance where we reasonably can.
Sections of these Terms that by their nature should last, including those on content ownership, disclaimers, liability, and governing law, continue after your account is closed.

Trading forex, futures, indices, commodities, cryptocurrencies and other leveraged products carries a high risk of losing money, and is not suitable for everyone. You can lose more than you expect. Results in simulations, practice tools, diagnostics and readiness scores are educational aids. They do not reflect real market conditions and do not predict your future results.

We work to keep the Academy accurate, available and secure, but we provide it "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows, we do not promise that the content is complete or free of errors, that the Academy will always be available, or that it will meet your particular goals.
Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, such as liability for fraud, or for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

Subject to that, we are not liable for trading losses or investment decisions, or for indirect or consequential loss, such as loss of profits, opportunity, data or goodwill, arising from your use of the Academy.

We do not pay compensation for any loss arising from your use of the Academy. Where the law does not allow us to exclude liability entirely, our total liability to you for all claims is limited to the amount you paid us for the course concerned in the 12 months before the claim arose.

If someone brings a claim against us because of content you posted or because you broke these Terms or the law, you agree to cover our reasonable losses and costs arising from that claim, to the extent the law allows.
If something goes wrong, please contact us first at support@fundedbeyond.com. Most concerns can be sorted out quickly, and we aim to respond and resolve yours within about 15 days.
These Terms are governed by the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the federal laws of the United Arab Emirates. The courts of Dubai have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

If you use the Academy as a consumer, you also keep the protection of any mandatory consumer laws of the country where you live, and you may bring a claim in the courts of that country where its law allows.

sections.title: Changes to the Academy and These Terms

blocks.text: We keep improving the Academy, so features and courses may change. We will not remove the core content of a paid course during your access period except for legal, safety or accuracy reasons.

We may update these Terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed. If a change is significant, we will tell you by email or in the Academy at least 14 days before it takes effect. If you do not agree to the new Terms, you can close your account before then. If you keep using the Academy after that, the new Terms apply.

items: These Terms and the Privacy Policy are the whole agreement between you and us about the Academy. Additional terms shown at checkout or on an offer page also apply to that purchase.
If a court finds part of these Terms unenforceable, the rest stays in effect.
If we do not enforce a right straight away, we can still enforce it later.
You may not transfer your rights under these Terms. We may transfer ours, for example if the business is reorganised or sold, and your rights will not be reduced as a result.
We are not responsible for delays or failures caused by events outside our reasonable control.
These Terms are written in English. If we provide a translation, the English version applies where they differ.

blocks.text: Questions about these Terms and notices can be sent to support@fundedbeyond.com. Our postal address is Beyond Edge FZCO, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

sections.title: Who We Are and What This Policy Covers

blocks.text: This Privacy Policy explains how Beyond Edge FZCO ("we", "us"), registered in the International Free Zone Authority (IFZA), Dubai, United Arab Emirates, handles personal data when you use FundedBeyond Academy at academy.fundedbeyond.com (the "Academy"). We decide how and why your personal data is used, which makes us responsible for it (the "controller" or "data fiduciary").
This policy covers the Academy only. When you visit fundedbeyond.com or buy a challenge there, its own privacy policy applies.

items: We collect what we need to run the Academy and teach you well, and no more.
We do not sell your personal data, and we do not show advertising in the Academy.
We only share data with service providers who help us run the Academy, under contracts that protect it.
You can see, download and correct your data, and ask us to delete it.
We protect your data with modern security and tell you if something goes wrong.
Account details: your name, email address and password. Passwords are stored only in hashed form, never readable.
Profile details you choose to add, such as a display name, profile photo, trading experience or goals.
Diagnostic and assessment answers, assignment submissions and anything else you submit while learning.
Community posts, comments and messages.

Billing details for paid courses, such as your billing name, address and tax details. These are stored encrypted. Card and bank details go straight to the payment processor and are never stored by us.
Messages you send to our support team.
Your agreement to our Terms and this policy: when you agreed, how (for example the sign-up form or Google), and which versions you agreed to.
Enrolments, lesson progress, video progress, quiz and assessment results, scores and time spent.
Your diagnostic results and readiness indicators.
Certificates issued to you.
Assessment monitoring signals, where an assessment uses monitoring (see the Assessment Monitoring section).
Device and connection data: IP address, browser and device type, operating system, and approximate location worked out from your IP address.
Sign-in and security data: when you sign in, your active sessions and devices, and security events such as failed sign-ins.
Usage data: pages viewed, features used and errors you run into.
Google: if you sign in with Google, Google shares your name, email address and profile picture with us.
Payment processor: when you buy a course, the processor tells us whether the payment succeeded and gives us a payment reference.
Our team: if an administrator invites you or enrols you in a course, they give us your name and email address.

blocks.text: We do not use your data to make decisions that have legal or similarly significant effects on you based solely on automated processing. Readiness scores and recommendations are guidance to help you learn.
Some assessments use monitoring to make sure results are fair. An assessment always tells you which level it uses and asks for your agreement before you start.

items: Level 1: records browser signals during the attempt, such as switching tabs, leaving full screen, and copying or pasting.

Level 2: also asks for access to your camera and microphone, to record whether someone is present and whether there is audio activity. If you refuse access or your camera is unavailable, you can still take the assessment with reduced monitoring.

blocks.text: Monitoring signals are reviewed by our team only to check the integrity of an attempt. Camera and microphone recordings are kept for 90 days and then deleted automatically, unless we need them for an open integrity review.
We share personal data only with the service providers below, who process it on our instructions and under contracts that require them to protect it, and only as needed for the service they provide.

blocks.text: We may also share personal data:

items: with our instructors and staff, who see your progress and submissions for the courses they teach or support;
with other members, but only what you choose to post in the community or show on your profile;
with anyone you give a certificate link to, who can see your name, the course and the date issued;
with authorities, regulators or courts when the law requires it, or to protect the rights and safety of our members, our team or the public;
with a buyer or successor if our business is reorganised or sold. They must protect your data as this policy describes.

blocks.text: When you follow a link from the Academy to fundedbeyond.com, the link carries a code so FundedBeyond can tell the visit came from the Academy. The code does not contain your name or email address.

Our main servers and database are in India. Some providers listed above process data in other countries, including the European Union and wherever Cloudflare's and Google's networks operate. When your data leaves your country, we rely on the provider's contractual commitments, such as standard contractual clauses, to keep it protected to the standard required by law.

blocks.text: Depending on where you live, you have some or all of these rights:

items: Access: ask what personal data we hold about you and how we use it.
Portability: download a copy of your data. You can do this yourself in your profile's privacy settings.
Correction: fix inaccurate or incomplete data. Most of it you can edit in your profile.

Deletion: ask us to delete your account and personal data. You can start this in your profile's privacy settings or by email. We complete deletion within 30 days. Some records are kept, as explained in How Long We Keep It: certificates, payment records and the record of your agreement are kept, and your community posts stay without your name.
Withdraw consent: stop marketing emails with the unsubscribe link, or withdraw consent for monitoring before an assessment. Withdrawing consent does not affect what was done before.
Objection and restriction: object to, or ask us to limit, processing based on our legitimate interests.
Nominate someone: if you are in India, you can nominate a person to exercise your rights if you die or become unable to do so.

Complain: contact our Grievance Officer (below), and, if you are not satisfied, the data protection authority where you live, such as the Data Protection Board of India or your local authority in the European Union, the United Kingdom or the United Arab Emirates.

blocks.text: To use any of these rights, email support@fundedbeyond.com from your account email address. We may need to confirm your identity first. We aim to respond within about 15 days. Deletion requests are completed within 30 days.

items: All connections to the Academy are encrypted.
Passwords are hashed, and sensitive details such as billing information are encrypted in storage.
Access to personal data is limited to the people who need it, and sensitive administrator actions require multi-factor authentication.
Each academy's data is kept separate from every other academy's.
We monitor our systems for errors and attacks.

blocks.text: No system is completely secure. If a breach affects your personal data, we will tell you and the relevant authorities as the law requires. You can help by using a strong, unique password and signing out on shared devices.

The Academy is for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has given us personal data, email support@fundedbeyond.com and we will delete it.

We may update this policy as the Academy or the law changes. The date at the top shows when it last changed. If a change significantly affects how we use your data, we will tell you by email or in the Academy before it takes effect, and ask for your consent again where the law requires.
For any question, request or complaint about your personal data, contact our Grievance Officer:

items: Email: support@fundedbeyond.com, with "Privacy" in the subject line
Post: Grievance Officer, Beyond Edge FZCO, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

blocks.text: We aim to acknowledge and resolve complaints within about 15 days. Complex cases may take longer, and we will keep you updated.
